title: Grand Slam Arena
intro: Minutes before the final whistle, the championship trophy vanished from the locked arena vault.
setting: A sold-out stadium during the championship final. A storm has cut the arena's outside power, trapping the cast inside until the backup generators stabilize.
timeline: The trophy was displayed in the vault before the second half began.
A brief power surge disabled the vault camera for ninety seconds.
The vault alarm reported a valid access code, but no exit alarm was triggered.
The trophy case was found empty just before the final whistle.

evidence.name: Camera gap
evidence.detail: The press-box camera lost its feed during the power surge.

evidence.name: Polish trail
evidence.detail: A faint line of trophy polish leads from the vault toward the service tunnel.

evidence.name: Access log
evidence.detail: The vault opened with a valid code belonging to someone on the arena staff.

evidence.name: Wet footprint
evidence.detail: A muddy footprint was found beside the emergency generator.

revelations: The theft required access to both the vault and the service tunnel.
The camera blackout was deliberate rather than a complete arena outage.
At least one alibi in the cast is technically true but leaves out an important detail.

endings.culpritsCaught: The trophy is recovered from the service tunnel, and the arena staff explain how the camera gap was created.
endings.culpritsEscape: The final whistle sounds while the trophy remains missing, and the culprit disappears into the evacuation crowd.

dialoguePrompts: Ask the person near the emergency generator why their shoes are wet.
Make the captain explain who else knows the vault combination.
Challenge the camera expert to describe the exact ninety-second blackout.
Have the ticket inspector identify the person seen leaving the vault corridor.

tasks.name: Rebuild the camera feed
tasks.detail: Use the press-box clock and scoreboard time to find the missing ninety seconds.

tasks.name: Trace the polish
tasks.detail: Follow the trophy polish trail and decide whether it was planted.

tasks.name: Check the service keys
tasks.detail: Compare the groundskeeper's key ring with the tunnel lock.

tasks.name: Secure the final whistle
tasks.detail: Keep the trophy search active until the official ending signal.

conflicts: The electrician claims the blackout was accidental, but the camera loop was too precise.
The former champion has a betting debt and says the trophy means nothing to them.
The medic can identify the polish but refuses to say whose gloves smelled of it.
The ticket inspector saw a figure, but the description changes each time.
secretObjectives: Recover the trophy for the team without exposing your own tunnel meeting.
Make the captain look guilty before the final whistle.
Protect the person who helped you access the service corridor.
Convince everyone that the camera evidence was corrupted by the storm.
twists: The trophy was moved twice, and the polish trail points to the first hiding place.
The camera loop was created using a maintenance tablet, not the scoreboard controls.
The person who reported the empty case had already touched the trophy.
